steps.prompt: Spirit hearse chariot body only, with NO wheels at all: a compact swept vermilion and black lacquer shrine cart box with empty bare axle stubs on each side where wheels would mount, an upturned temple-roof canopy over a caged glowing teal soul-lantern, three curved iron scythe blades on a crossbar at the front sweeping low, a hooded faceless robed charioteer figure at the front holding a tall hooked iron staff. Seen from a telephoto side three-quarter view. Photograph of a real museum-quality handcrafted East Asian temple artefact: glossy cinnabar-red and black urushi lacquer, carved celadon jade, mother-of-pearl inlay, hand-applied gold leaf and carved granite, crisp real material wear and patina, warm soft studio light. Single isolated object, the entire object in frame with margin, centered, three-quarter front view from slightly above, even soft studio lighting, no cast shadow, plain light-grey seamless background. No text, no logos, no lettering, no numbers, no brand marks, no emblems anywhere on the object.
